title: Mentoring on vocational skills
text: Queen's University mentored TUSOME on integrating vocational skills development into its platform, in line with Tanzania's competence-based curriculum.

title: TABASAM showcased at eLearning Africa
text: TABASAM was showcased at the eLearning Africa conference, where the team joined workshops on inclusive early learning and foundational skills.

title: Online assessment with personalised learning plans
text: Informed by user testing, TABASAM moved from a lengthy offline assessment to an online tool that generates personalised learning plans for teachers.

title: New assessment and offline features
text: Literacy and numeracy assessments, social-emotional learning tracking, behaviour monitoring and offline functionality for low-connectivity settings were added to TABASAM.

title: Technical boot camp and AI workshops
text: The team joined the fellowship's technical boot camp and AI and data science workshops, applying the skills to refine TABASAM's features.

title: Education and wellbeing forums
text: The team took part in the African Cities Forum and the Tanzania Mental Health Summit.

title: Korogwe teachers trained on TABASAM
text: A workshop in Korogwe trained teachers to use the TABASAM diagnostic tool in their schools.

title: Field feedback shapes TABASAM updates
text: Feedback from Korogwe outreach led to more accurate assessments, simpler interfaces and content for diverse learning needs.

title: TABASAM presented in Nairobi
text: TABASAM was presented as a story of change at a Foundation for Learning conference in Nairobi organised by Aga Khan University.

title: Online mentoring for Korogwe teachers
text: Korogwe teachers received online mentoring on learning disabilities and on using TABASAM reports to plan classroom support.

title: Outreach in Mwanza
text: Outreach took TABASAM to primary schools in Mwanza and to Butimba Teachers College, including an AI literacy session for student teachers.

title: Streamlined reports and local guidance
text: TABASAM gained streamlined reporting features and localised guidance modules in response to teacher feedback.

title: Agreement with Cardinal Rugambwa Hospital
text: TUSOME signed a memorandum of understanding with Cardinal Rugambwa Hospital to support children with disabilities in its rehabilitation programme.

title: Improved navigation and reports
text: TABASAM's navigation and reports were improved, giving teachers and parents clearer summaries and individual learning recommendations.

title: TABASAM exhibited at Sahara Sparks
text: TABASAM was demonstrated at the Sahara Sparks 2025 exhibition in Dar es Salaam.

title: Analytical dashboard design begins
text: Design began on a TABASAM analytical dashboard to track learner progress in literacy, numeracy and behaviour.

title: Teachers using TABASAM reports
text: Trained teachers in urban and peri-urban schools used TABASAM diagnostic reports to guide classroom support.

title: Teacher digital-readiness survey
text: With Carnegie Mellon University, the team surveyed teachers in the Tanga pilot on their technology awareness, skills and attitudes.

title: TABASAM in more Korogwe schools
text: TABASAM was introduced to new teachers and administrators in additional schools in Korogwe.

title: AI-assisted learning plans refined
text: AI-assisted components of TABASAM were refined to make individual education plan development faster.

title: Purposeful AI at a founders meetup
text: At a Tech Founders Meetup, TUSOME presented TABASAM and argued for purposeful use of AI to support teachers and learning.

title: Teachers trained on updated features
text: Teachers in Korogwe District government schools were trained on updated TABASAM features and gave structured feedback.

title: Follow-up teacher survey
text: A follow-up survey of Korogwe teachers with Carnegie Mellon University allowed comparison of changes in attitudes, skills and technology use.

title: Carnegie Mellon University testbed
text: TUSOME took part in a Carnegie Mellon University testbed to validate data collection tools and refine research workflows.

title: Korogwe data collection continues
text: Data collection continued in participating Korogwe schools using TABASAM-informed classroom practice.

title: Morogoro community outreach
text: Outreach through local radio and the district education office in Morogoro invited schools and teachers to join the next cohort.

title: Joint data analysis
text: The team analysed school data with Carnegie Mellon University and helped refine research protocols.

title: Classroom observations in Korogwe
text: Classroom observations and teacher discussions in Korogwe informed improvements to TABASAM's usability.

title: Queen's University delegation visits
text: Teacher candidates and professors from Queen's University visited schools and institutions where TABASAM is in use.

title: Progress presented at Demo Day
text: TUSOME presented its product, research and implementation progress at the EdTech Fellowship Demo Day.

title: TABASAM in new institutions
text: TABASAM was introduced to new schools and to a teachers' college specialising in special education.

title: Follow-up support for partner schools
text: The team followed up with partner schools to support teachers, monitor TABASAM use and gather classroom feedback.

title: Education conferences and forums
text: TUSOME shared TABASAM implementation experience at education conferences and stakeholder forums.

title: New schools onboarded
text: New schools were onboarded to TABASAM and began using the platform with implementation support.

title: Korogwe study analysis
text: Analysis of the Korogwe study data continued with Carnegie Mellon University.

title: Contribution to eLearning Africa
text: TUSOME was invited to contribute to eLearning Africa discussions, sharing lessons from TABASAM implementation.

title: Holiday learning programme
text: Learners took part in TABASAM-supported learning activities during a June school-holiday programme.

title: Community education events
text: The team took part in community education events, raising awareness of TABASAM among educators, parents and stakeholders.

title: Linking assessment to teacher guidance
text: Development focused on connecting learner assessment results with practical recommendations and professional development guidance for teachers.

title: Continued school and community engagement
text: TABASAM implementation continued through follow-up with participating schools, institutions and communities.

title: Guest speakers at international conference
text: TUSOME was invited to speak at an international education conference on using TABASAM for assessment and inclusive education.

title: Grade 2 examination pilot
text: TABASAM was used to support a pilot of Grade 2 examinations, testing administration, data capture, usability and reporting.

title: TUSOME Technologies Limited formed
text: TUSOME completed its company formation, becoming TUSOME Technologies Limited.
